notes:
Summary: Sundial builds a blended cloud/contact-center platform used by retail and telco CX teams. They want to replace slow KB lookups and fragile heuristics with a RAG-based agent assist layer. Primary goals: accurate citations, freshness guarantees, multi-source retrieval across internal KB + ticket DB + product change logs.

Key stakeholders: Ae (Maeve) owns buying; Ravi (SE) doing POC; Alina will own onboarding/CSM. Product lead (Anika) is technical contact, cares about traceability (which doc produced the answer). Legal and InfoSec are heavy on retention and residency for EU customers.

POC scope and milestones (timeline shorthand):
- 2026-01-12: kickoff call (fireflies ff_20260122_3a9b).
- 2026-01-25: ingestion workshop: 3 sources (Confluence KB, Zendesk ticket dump, Product Changelog S3).
- 2026-02-05: initial retrieval config (bm25+embedding hybrid), 80% correct citation in dev queries.
- 2026-02-16: agent-assist prototype (tool-calling to internal ticketing, auto-draft reply) demo to ops team.
- 2026-02-18: synthetic spike test (500req/s) — saw latency tail at 800ms, under investigation (batching config + gateway throttles).
- 2026-02-20: added freshness pipeline (nearline ingest + doc TTL) - still validating freshness window for changelogs.

Requirements / success metrics (customer phrasing):
- "Agent suggestions must include exact KB citation or ticket id 90% of the time."
- Summaries < 2s for single-ticket summarization path; agent-assist flows < 600ms 95p under normal load.
- Tool-calls (create-ticket, escalate, add-tag) must have idempotency and audit log entries.
- Must be able to pin a model family for EU-resident traffic.

Technical preferences & notes:
- Prefer open model family (LlamaX variants) for cost control but want fallback to Redwood-hosted higher-quality model during spikes.
- Considering using Pinecone vs in-house faiss for vector store; identity of vector DB ops is main blocker for go/no-go.
- Want automatic citation extraction (title, url, ticket id) and a confidence score attached to every suggestion.
- Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching + quant profiles) to bring token costs down.

Security / compliance path:
- Need SSO/SAML integration and SCIM for agent provisioning (legal requirement).
- KMS integration required for encryption-at-rest keys; enterprise wants HSM option early.
- Data residency: EU customers must be served from EU-only model routing.
- Audit log sampling must be exportable to their SIEM (Splunk).

Commercial / pricing notes:
- Will start with a 6-week paid POC (~$25k) to validate latency + RAG precision. If POC passes, plan is 12-month Dedicated contract (baseline 4 GPUs with burst to 8).
- Procurement timeline tied to enterprise legal; forecast: Apr 2026.
